summary: Master GIS mapping and spatial analysis with our ArcGIS Desktop course. Gain practical skills to analyze geographic data and make informed decisions.
lede: GIS Mapping and Spatial Analysis using ArcGIS Desktop teaches you to gather, manage, and analyze geographic data to reveal patterns, relationships, and actionable spatial insights. You will build structured geodatabases, align coordinate systems, perform multi-criteria spatial queries, model surfaces with raster data, and communicate findings through professional cartography. Across five days, you will practice geoprocessing with the Spatial Analyst extension and explore automation through ArcPy and ModelBuilder. The course also provides practical workflows for managing data quality, working within hardware constraints, and applying spatial analysis to infrastructure, environmental, logistical, and commercial projects.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who manage location-based data and need to produce high-quality spatial analysis for decision support.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data management and computer file systems. Prior experience with mapping concepts is helpful but not required. A laptop with ArcGIS Pro installed (trial or licensed) is necessary for the hands-on exercises.
